name: agent-orchestration
description: Turn one explicitly designated Codex task into a Goal Mode control plane for existing tasks in the same project.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate project tasks from a Goal Mode control plane.
interface.longDescription: Explicitly turns the current Codex task into a project-scoped Goal Mode control plane that clarifies the operator objective, tracks existing tasks, coordinates bounded waits and follow-ups, keeps a concise issue/PR/status title, closes out eligible work, and supports reversible archive recovery.
defaultPrompt: Make this task the control plane for the current project.
Use this as the main session and coordinate the existing project tasks.
Resume this orchestration task and close out completed work.
